about: The Oxy SDK's request to sign in again (docs/adr/0020-oxy-account-login.mdx, decision 5; sample/oxyos/session-host.js) locks the session, as the application's window is the active one (docs/adr/0010-lock-screen.mdx); unlocking checks the password with Oxy online.
